description:
498 tiles at 16x16 for a crystal cavern: dark fractured cavestone, glow lichen, amethyst crystal fields, a quartz-sand trail, and raised geode walls with a violet crystal lip, with crystal clusters in four hues, columns and spires, geodes, stalagmites and flowstone, a rune obelisk, a crystal altar and a miners' camp. Commercial use permitted, in unlimited projects, with no attribution required; the one thing you may not do is resell or redistribute the pack itself.

Importers for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled and Godot ship in the download, and each was run by the engine it targets and made to count what it built.

What is in the download

  • 329 of the 498 tiles are transitions, 66% of the pack. 7 complete 47-mask autotile sets: every inner corner, outer corner, edge, junction and single. Completeness is checked mechanically on every build, because a set missing three tiles is broken in your map.
  • The floors meet each other, not only the stone. Lichen, amethyst and the quartz trail each meet the cave floor; amethyst grows over lichen, and the trail crosses both the lichen and the amethyst with its own sets, so one floor lays over another without a strip of bare stone between them.
  • A raised geode wall that reads as raised: lit on its north and west shoulders, a south face with a violet crystal lip where it turns over, and a shadow on the east.
  • 5 materials × 4 variants on a value ladder laid out before any art existed, so the cave does not collapse into one undifferentiated dark. The smallest gap on the ladder is 16.6 luma, measured from the shipped pixels.
  • 44 objects across 85 tiles: amethyst, teal, rose and citrine crystal clusters, an amethyst column and a quartz spire, split and whole geodes, stalagmites, a flowstone column and a rimstone pool, tall cave mushrooms, a rune obelisk, a crystal altar and a crystal skull, and the miners' camp: a timber support, a cart of crystals, a pick left in a rock, a crystal chest and the rail's end stop. Each ships transparent, and grounded on the floor it belongs to with the contact shadow drawn.
  • 4 animated objects, 64 frames: a pulsing heart crystal, water dripping into a pool, glowing mushrooms and a miner's lantern. The silhouette holds still; only the light and the water move.
  • A finished 40x28 sample map with 135 objects on it and every autotile set placed, as a PNG, as JSON naming every cell by tile id, and as a .tmx that opens in Tiled.
  • 20 4x4 proof renders, one per repeating tile, so you can look for the grid line yourself.
  • Every tile as a loose PNG and as packed sheets: 577 files in total, and a tiles.json giving every tile's role, material, sheet slot, footprint and passability.

One thing to know before you buy

⚠️ The animation plays in Tiled and Godot, not in RPG Maker MZ. MZ animates tiles only through its A1 page, which holds animated water autotiles; this pack has none, so in MZ the animated objects arrive as static frames on pages C and D.

The importers were actually run

  • RPG Maker MZ: an A2 autotile sheet (the page MZ's own autotile brush paints) plus B/C/D object pages and a slot map. It composes correctly against MZ's own FLOOR_AUTOTILE_TABLE: 7 of 7 sets, 329 of 329 masked tiles, and 336 of 336 shapes came back byte-identical. The object pages carry every fill, every object and every animation frame.
  • Tiled: one .tsx per group, all 11 opened and rendered by Tiled 1.12.2's own tmxrasterizer and compared pixel for pixel with the shipped sheets: 616 sheet cells, 0 differing. The sample map's .tmx renders 1,146,880 pixels identical to the shipped PNG.
  • Godot 4: a .tres TileSet, loaded and verified in Godot 4.7.2: 11 atlas sources, 498 of 498 declared tiles built, 73 of 73 multi-cell footprints exact. Every sheet is referenced by a relative filename, so the folder loads from wherever you put it in a project.

What is proven, and what is not

The grid is exact, the palette is locked to 79 colours, the alpha is strictly binary with no anti-aliasing, every tile carries a declared role, and every autotile set is complete: exact checks, run on every build.

Seamlessness is not on that list. Every tile's wrap boundary is measured against its own interior, and every 4x4 repetition is rendered and reviewed; grid, palette and autotile completeness are machine-proven. The renders ship with the pack so you can judge them yourself.

The autotile sets

  • lichen_on_cavestone
  • amethyst_on_cavestone
  • quartz_on_cavestone
  • amethyst_on_lichen
  • quartz_on_amethyst
  • quartz_on_lichen
  • geodewall_on_cavestone

It fits the rest of the series

The 16x16 Verdant packs are drawn at one cell size in one style, so this cavern sits beside the others.

AI disclosure

Tagged as AI-assisted. Precisely: every tile is drawn by a procedural generator written for this series, and that generator's code was written with AI assistance. No diffusion model is anywhere in the tile pipeline. Every image on this page, the cover included, is composed from the pack's own tiles and sample map.
